title: Humans vs. Machines: A Comparison With AI Agents in Software Reverse Engineering
title_zh: 人类 vs. 机器：软件逆向工程中的 AI 智能体对比

paragraphs.en: Can an autonomous AI agent reverse engineer a binary as well as a skilled human analyst? If so, do they adopt the same analysis strategy, and can agents scale to real-world programs?
paragraphs.zh: 自主人工智能智能体能否像经验丰富的分析师一样对二进制文件进行逆向工程？ 如果可以，它们是否会采用相同的分析策略？智能体能否处理现实世界中的程序？

sents.en: Can an autonomous AI agent reverse engineer a binary as well as a skilled human analyst?
sents.zh: 自主人工智能智能体能否像经验丰富的分析师一样对二进制文件进行逆向工程？

sents.en: If so, do they adopt the same analysis strategy, and can agents scale to real-world programs?
sents.zh: 如果可以，它们是否会采用相同的分析策略？智能体能否处理现实世界中的程序？

paragraphs.en: We study these questions through a controlled comparison of human and LLM-based software reverse engineering (SRE). We evaluate nine models on two compact, static-analysis reverse-engineering challenges previously solved by human analysts, using a common understanding rubric, and record their complete interactions with IDA Pro. This lets us compare not only what humans and agents recover, but also how they investigate a binary.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过对人类和基于大型语言模型（LLM）的软件逆向工程（SRE）进行受控比较，来研究这些问题。 我们使用共同的评估标准，在两项此前由人类分析师解决的紧凑型静态分析逆向工程挑战上对九个模型进行了评估，并记录了它们与 IDA Pro 的完整交互过程。 这使我们不仅能比较人类和智能体所恢复的内容，还能比较它们调查二进制文件的方式。

sents.en: We study these questions through a controlled comparison of human and LLM-based software reverse engineering (SRE).
sents.zh: 我们通过对人类和基于大型语言模型（LLM）的软件逆向工程（SRE）进行受控比较，来研究这些问题。

sents.en: We evaluate nine models on two compact, static-analysis reverse-engineering challenges previously solved by human analysts, using a common understanding rubric, and record their complete interactions with IDA Pro.

sents.en: This lets us compare not only what humans and agents recover, but also how they investigate a binary.
sents.zh: 这使我们不仅能比较人类和智能体所恢复的内容，还能比较它们调查二进制文件的方式。

paragraphs.en: The best-performing agents (GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, and Kimi K3) achieve statistically human-competitive understanding on both tasks, while weaker models remain substantially behind. Ablation studies reveal that this gap is shaped by both the code representation and the demands of the workflow, rather than by model capability alone: while open-weight models improve substantially when provided with richer code representations, we detect no significant change for frontier models. Yet, these similar success rates hide fundamentally different workflows. Humans repeatedly revisit functions and follow local program structure; strong agents instead jump aggressively across the binary, retrieve information broadly, and rarely return to previously inspected code, a behavior we call greedy fetching . This strategy is not fixed: when agents receive semantically richer code, they fetch less of it without losing understanding, showing that agent behavior is strongly shaped by the information interface.
paragraphs.zh: 表现最佳的智能体（GPT-5.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4.8 和 Kimi K3）在两项任务中都达到了统计上可与人类相媲美的理解水平，而较弱的模型则明显落后。 消融研究表明，这种差距既由代码表示方式决定，也由工作流程的需求所影响，而非仅取决于模型能力：当为开放权重模型提供更丰富的代码表示时，其表现会显著提升；但对于前沿模型，我们并未观察到显著变化。 然而，这些看似相似的成功率背后，隐藏着根本不同的工作流程。 人类会反复回顾函数并遵循局部程序结构；而强大的智能体则会在二进制文件中快速跳跃、广泛检索信息，且很少返回之前检查过的代码——我们将这种行为称为“贪婪获取”。 这种策略并非固定不变：当智能体接收到语义更丰富的代码时，它们无需理解能力下降即可减少代码的获取量，这表明智能体的行为在很大程度上受到信息接口的影响。

sents.en: This strategy is not fixed: when agents receive semantically richer code, they fetch less of it without losing understanding, showing that agent behavior is strongly shaped by the information interface.
sents.zh: 这种策略并非固定不变：当智能体接收到语义更丰富的代码时，它们无需理解能力下降即可减少代码的获取量，这表明智能体的行为在很大程度上受到信息接口的影响。

paragraphs.en: Because greedy fetching relies on aggregating massive amounts of retrieved code into the agent’s memory, it raises a critical scalability question. To test these limits, we measure context-window saturation across 4,000 real-world binaries and find that, although large context windows accommodate many programs, larger applications and lower-level representations quickly consume this capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 由于贪婪式获取依赖于将大量检索到的代码整合到智能体的记忆中，因此它引发了一个关键的扩展性问题。 为了测试这些限制，我们测量了 4000 个真实世界二进制文件中的上下文窗口饱和情况，并发现：尽管较大的上下文窗口可以容纳许多程序，但规模更大的应用程序和更低层的表示形式会迅速耗尽这种容量。

sents.en: Because greedy fetching relies on aggregating massive amounts of retrieved code into the agent’s memory, it raises a critical scalability question.

sents.en: To test these limits, we measure context-window saturation across 4,000 real-world binaries and find that, although large context windows accommodate many programs, larger applications and lower-level representations quickly consume this capacity.
sents.zh: 为了测试这些限制，我们测量了 4000 个真实世界二进制文件中的上下文窗口饱和情况，并发现：尽管较大的上下文窗口可以容纳许多程序，但规模更大的应用程序和更低层的表示形式会迅速耗尽这种容量。

paragraphs.en: Our results show that autonomous reverse engineering is becoming competitive, with the enormous advantage of speed, but scaling it will require better navigation, selective retrieval, and persistent analysis state, not merely larger context windows.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果表明，自主逆向工程正变得具有竞争力，其巨大的优势在于速度，但要实现规模化应用，还需要更出色的导航能力、选择性检索以及持续的分析状态，而不仅仅是更大的上下文窗口。

paragraphs.en: Modern security practice depends on analyzing software that was not written, documented, or compiled for the analyst: malware, proprietary applications, legacy components, and third-party programs often arrive only as binaries, yet analysts must still secure and understand them. This is the role of Software Reverse Engineering (SRE): recovering meaning from programs whose semantics have been removed or were never available, a critical process that remains labor-intensive, primarily human-driven, and dependent on expertise ( Mantovani et al., 2022 ; Votipka et al., 2020 ; Nosco et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现代安全实践依赖于对未经编写、记录或为分析人员编译过的软件进行分析：恶意软件、专有应用程序、遗留组件和第三方程序通常仅以二进制文件形式出现，但分析人员仍然必须确保其安全性并理解其功能。 这正是软件逆向工程（SRE）的作用：从语义已被移除或从未公开的程序中恢复其含义。这一关键过程仍然劳动密集、主要依赖人工操作，并且需要专业知识的支撑（Mantovani 等，2022；Votipka 等，2020；Nosco 等，2020）。

sents.en: Modern security practice depends on analyzing software that was not written, documented, or compiled for the analyst: malware, proprietary applications, legacy components, and third-party programs often arrive only as binaries, yet analysts must still secure and understand them.
sents.zh: 现代安全实践依赖于对未经编写、记录或为分析人员编译过的软件进行分析：恶意软件、专有应用程序、遗留组件和第三方程序通常仅以二进制文件形式出现，但分析人员仍然必须确保其安全性并理解其功能。

sents.zh: 这正是软件逆向工程（SRE）的作用：从语义已被移除或从未公开的程序中恢复其含义。这一关键过程仍然劳动密集、主要依赖人工操作，并且需要专业知识的支撑（Mantovani 等，2022；Votipka 等，2020；Nosco 等，2020）。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising way to reduce this bottleneck. Recent studies have explored their use across SRE-related tasks, including code interpretation, function and symbol recovery, binary understanding, vulnerability analysis, and deobfuscation ( Pearce et al., 2022 ; Pordanesh and Tan, 2024 ; Shang et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Shang et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Manuel et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Tkachenko et al., 2025 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) , and human–LLM teaming has been found to improve SRE performance ( Basque et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究已经表明，大型语言模型（LLM）为缓解这一瓶颈提供了一种有前景的方法。 近期的研究探索了它们在软件可靠性工程（SRE）相关任务中的应用，包括代码解释、函数和符号恢复、二进制文件理解、漏洞分析以及反混淆（Pearce 等，2022；Pordanesh 和 Tan，2024；Shang 等，2024；Yu 等，2025；Hu 等，2024；Jiang 等，2025；Xie 等，2024；Xu 等，2025；Shang 等，2026；Hu 等，2025；Manuel 等，2024；Fang 等，2024；Deng 等，2024；Li 等，2025；Tkachenko 等，2025；Choi 等，2026），并且研究发现人类与大型语言模型的合作能够提升 SRE 的性能（Basque 等，2026）。

sents.en: Prior work has shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising way to reduce this bottleneck.
sents.zh: 先前的研究已经表明，大型语言模型（LLM）为缓解这一瓶颈提供了一种有前景的方法。

paragraphs.en: Recently, tool-using LLM systems (hereafter agents ) have moved LLM-based security analysis from interactive assistance toward increasingly autonomous execution ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Nishizaka et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2025 ) . In SRE, this shift raises a question that goes beyond whether an agent can simply solve a challenge: can an AI agent reach a program understanding comparable to that of a human reverse engineer? What strategies does it use to do so? Can those strategies scale to larger programs? While recent studies demonstrate substantial progress in autonomous binary analysis and security-agent evaluation ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Shao et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) , they typically evaluate agents against fixed suites of challenge binaries, scoring them purely on pass/fail flag recovery or scripted “golden” paths, rather than comparing how humans and agents investigate the program. The question of whether agents navigate and understand binaries using the same analytical strategies as humans remains largely unexplored in a controlled SRE setting.
paragraphs.zh: 近期，使用工具的大型语言模型系统（下文称为“智能体”）已将基于大型语言模型的安全分析从交互式辅助转向了日益自主的执行模式（Chen et al., 2025b；Nishizaka et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026；Ji et al., 2025）。 在软件可靠性工程（SRE）领域，这一转变引发了一个超越“智能体能否直接解决某个挑战”的问题：人工智能智能体能否达到与人类逆向工程师相当的程序理解能力？ 它是通过哪些策略来实现这一点的？ 这些策略能否扩展到更大的程序中？ 尽管近期的研究展示了在自主二进制分析和安全智能体评估方面的显著进展（Liu et al., 2026；Shao et al., 2026；Tang et al., 2026），但这些研究通常通过固定的一组挑战性二进制文件来评估智能体，仅根据是否成功恢复标志或遵循脚本化的“黄金”路径进行评分，而非比较人类和智能体在程序分析上的方法差异。 在受控的软件可靠性工程环境中，智能体是否使用与人类相同的分析策略来解析和理解二进制文件这一问题，在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

sents.en: What strategies does it use to do so?
sents.zh: 它是通过哪些策略来实现这一点的？

sents.en: Can those strategies scale to larger programs?
sents.zh: 这些策略能否扩展到更大的程序中？

sents.zh: 在受控的软件可靠性工程环境中，智能体是否使用与人类相同的分析策略来解析和理解二进制文件这一问题，在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

paragraphs.en: SRE provides a particularly useful setting for such a comparison because the final answer is only part of the analysis: the functions inspected, relationships followed, and information revisited expose how an analyst progressively builds understanding. We therefore conduct a matched, instrumented comparison in which autonomous agents and human reverse engineers analyze the same binaries under a common understanding rubric, mapping their tool interactions into shared SRE abstractions to compare what they recover, how they navigate a binary, and whether the resulting strategies remain feasible as program size grows.
paragraphs.zh: SRE 为这类比较提供了一个尤为有用的场景，因为最终答案只是分析的一部分：被检查的函数、追踪的关系以及重新审视的信息，都揭示了分析师如何逐步建立理解。 因此，我们进行了一项匹配且经过工具化的比较研究：自主智能体与人类逆向工程师在同一理解标准下分析相同的二进制文件，将他们的工具交互映射到共享的 SRE 抽象模型中，以比较他们恢复的内容、探索二进制文件的方式，以及随着程序规模增长，所形成的策略是否仍然可行。

sents.en: We therefore conduct a matched, instrumented comparison in which autonomous agents and human reverse engineers analyze the same binaries under a common understanding rubric, mapping their tool interactions into shared SRE abstractions to compare what they recover, how they navigate a binary, and whether the resulting strategies remain feasible as program size grows.

paragraphs.en: Our study is guided by four research questions that jointly assess the capability, limitations, behavioral strategies, and scalability of autonomous SRE agents compared with humans:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究以四个研究问题为指引，这些问题共同评估了与人类相比，自主 SRE 智能体的能力、局限性、行为策略和可扩展性：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Do agents perform reverse engineering at the same competency level as human experts? We evaluate whether autonomous agents can reach a practically non-inferior level of understanding relative to a top-human reference cohort.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题1：智能体的逆向工程能力是否与人类专家处于同一水平？ 我们评估了自主智能体能否在理解能力上达到与顶尖人类参考群体相比实际上不逊色的水平。

sents.en: RQ1: Do agents perform reverse engineering at the same competency level as human experts?
sents.zh: 研究问题1：智能体的逆向工程能力是否与人类专家处于同一水平？

sents.en: We evaluate whether autonomous agents can reach a practically non-inferior level of understanding relative to a top-human reference cohort.
sents.zh: 我们评估了自主智能体能否在理解能力上达到与顶尖人类参考群体相比实际上不逊色的水平。

paragraphs.en: RQ2: What limits agent reverse-engineering performance? We use ablation studies to examine which failure modes, representation effects, and interaction bottlenecks contribute to the gap between frontier and open-weight agents.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题 2：是什么限制了智能体逆向工程的性能？ 我们通过消融研究来考察哪些失效模式、表示效应和交互瓶颈导致了前沿智能体与开放权重智能体之间的性能差距。

sents.en: RQ2: What limits agent reverse-engineering performance?
sents.zh: 研究问题 2：是什么限制了智能体逆向工程的性能？

sents.en: We use ablation studies to examine which failure modes, representation effects, and interaction bottlenecks contribute to the gap between frontier and open-weight agents.
sents.zh: 我们通过消融研究来考察哪些失效模式、表示效应和交互瓶颈导致了前沿智能体与开放权重智能体之间的性能差距。

paragraphs.en: RQ3: How do agents’ and humans’ strategies differ? We turn the workflow-related limitations identified in RQ2 into a strategy explanation by comparing how successful agents and humans move through binaries at the macro level (transitions between high-level analysis phases) and micro level (call-graph navigation).
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题3：智能体与人类的策略有何不同？ 我们将研究问题2中识别出的工作流程相关局限性转化为策略解释，通过比较成功智能体与人类在宏观层面（高级分析阶段之间的转换）和微观层面（调用图导航）上如何遍历二进制结构。

sents.en: RQ3: How do agents’ and humans’ strategies differ?

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions, we present, to our knowledge, the first controlled human–agent comparison in SRE that directly aligns challenge binaries, an understanding rubric, and behavioral traces, using an instrumented pipeline that repeatedly runs each agent through a standardized SRE framework interface (IDA Pro via MCP) and logs all tool interactions. By scoring agents’ writeups on the identical challenges and the same understanding-point system used in a prior human study ( Basque et al., 2026 ) , we examine both what agents achieve and how their workflows differ from human analysts’.
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这些问题，我们提出了据我们所知 SRE 领域首次受控的智能体与人类对比研究。该研究直接对齐了挑战的二进制结果、理解评分标准以及行为轨迹，并通过一个经过工具集成的流程反复让每个智能体运行于标准化的 SRE 框架接口（通过 MCP 访问 IDA Pro），并记录所有工具交互。 通过对智能体在相同挑战和同一理解要点体系下的分析报告进行评分（该体系曾用于先前的人类研究，Basque et al., 2026），我们既考察了智能体的实际成果，也分析了其工作流程与人类分析师的差异。

paragraphs.en: Human-competitive understanding turns out to be strongly model-dependent: in a one-point non-inferiority test against the top human reference, GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, and Kimi K3 achieve top-human-level understanding on both challenges, whereas other open-weight models achieve it only on one challenge. Ablations show why: providing complete decompiled programs directly yields substantially larger gains than returning source code over the same MCP loop, especially for open-weight models, while disassembly-only inputs help less: representation quality, search burden, and workflow demands all contribute. Trace analysis shows this success does not stem from human-like navigation: agents cover similarly broad portions of the binary but jump nonlinearly and revisit far less often, a behavior we call greedy fetching . Finally, a context-window feasibility analysis over real-world binaries bounds this strategy: full-context analysis remains feasible for many binaries, especially with decompiled representations, but becomes unreliable as size grows or representation density worsens.
paragraphs.zh: 事实证明，达到人类水平的理解能力高度依赖模型：在与顶尖人类参考模型（GPT-5.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4.8 和 Kimi K3）进行单点非劣效性测试时，这些模型在两项挑战中均实现了人类顶级水平的理解能力，而其他开放权重模型仅能在其中一项挑战中达到该水平。 消融分析揭示了原因：直接提供完整的反编译程序比在相同的 MCP 循环中返回源代码能带来显著更大的提升，尤其对开放权重模型而言；而仅仅提供反汇编输入的帮助则较小——表示质量、搜索负担和工作流需求均对此产生影响。 轨迹分析表明，这种成功并非源于类人类的导航方式：智能体虽然覆盖了二进制程序中大致相同广度的内容，但其跳转是非线性的，且重访频率低得多——我们将这种行为称为“贪婪获取”。 最后，针对真实世界二进制程序进行上下文窗口可行性分析，为该策略设定了界限：对于许多二进制程序而言，全上下文分析仍然是可行的，尤其是在使用反编译表示的情况下；但随着程序规模增大或表示密度恶化，这种方法的可靠性会下降。

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, we present the first controlled, end-to-end human–agent SRE comparison that aligns the binaries, understanding score rubric, and interaction traces, enabling direct comparison of both outcomes and analysis strategies. paragraphs.en: We show that agents can achieve human-level understanding, but this capability is model-dependent: GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, and Kimi K3 are non-inferior to the top human reference on both compact challenges within a one-point margin, while the remaining six evaluated agents perform substantially less consistently.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，智能体可以实现人类水平的理解能力，但这种能力取决于具体模型：GPT-5.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4.8 和 Kimi K3 在紧凑型挑战任务上的表现与顶尖的人类参考结果相比，差距不超过一个百分点，而其他六个受评估的智能体则表现出明显更低的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: We identify greedy fetching , a distinctive agent SRE strategy: rather than repeatedly revisiting and refining previously-inspected code, strong agents aggressively fetch new information across the binary. We show that this strategy achieves coverage comparable to humans.
paragraphs.zh: 我们识别出一种贪婪式获取策略，这是一种独特的智能体 SRE 策略：与反复回顾和精炼之前已检查过的代码不同，强大的智能体会在整个二进制文件中积极获取新信息。 我们证明，这种策略实现的覆盖范围可与人类相媲美。

paragraphs.en: We quantify the scalability limits of full-context SRE using 4,000 real-world binaries. Even with a 1M-token context window, decompiled programs exceed the available context in 1.9%–39.1% of binaries, depending on the binary group; disassembly further increases the required context by roughly 2 × 2\times .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 4,000 个真实世界的二进制文件，量化了全上下文 SRE 的可扩展性极限。 即使使用 100 万词元的上下文窗口，反编译后的程序在 1.9%–39.1% 的二进制文件中仍会超出可用上下文（具体比例因二进制文件组而异）；而反汇编还会进一步将所需上下文增加约 2 × 2\times。

paragraphs.en: Overall, our findings show that the strongest agents can achieve top-human outcomes on compact SRE tasks, but this capability is heterogeneous and stems from a navigation policy that differs substantially from that of unassisted human reverse engineering. Scaling that capability beyond favorable settings will require selective retrieval, persistent state, and more deliberate navigation rather than indiscriminate full-context acquisition.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，最强的智能体能够在紧凑的 SRE 任务中达到与顶尖人类相当的结果，但这种能力存在异质性，且源于一种与无人协助的人类逆向工程截然不同的导航策略。 要将这种能力扩展到有利设置之外的场景，就需要选择性地检索信息、维持持续的状态，并采取更审慎的导航方式，而非不加区分地获取全部上下文信息。

paragraphs.en: Human Reverse Engineering Workflows. Votipka et al. ( Votipka et al., 2020 ) characterize reverse engineering as iterative exploration, hypothesis formation, and validation, while Mantovani et al. ( Mantovani et al., 2022 ) analyze humans’ cognitive strategies and information needs. Aonzo et al. ( Aonzo et al., 2023 ) compare human and machine decisions in malware classification. Closest to our human data source, Basque et al. ( Basque et al., 2026 ) study human–LLM teaming in SRE using writeups and IDA logs from 48 participants. They define understanding rate as the score divided by solve time, show that it discriminates self-reported experts from novices, and use rate-ranked top- and bottom-ranked cohorts for strategy analysis. paragraphs.en: LLMs for Software Reverse Engineering. Prior studies test LLMs for decompiled-code interpretation ( Pearce et al., 2022 ; Pordanesh and Tan, 2024 ; Shang et al., 2024 ) , decompiler refinement ( Hu et al., 2024 ) , function-name and symbol recovery ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) , and broader binary understanding ( Shang et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . Representation quality (including pseudocode, intermediate representations, and recovered semantic information) strongly affects usefulness ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Pelayo-Benedet et al., 2026 ) . Work on vulnerability analysis and assembly deobfuscation similarly shows that source-level competence does not transfer directly to binary settings ( Manuel et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2024 ; Tkachenko et al., 2025 ; Choi et al., 2026 ) . These studies establish useful SRE subtasks but provide less evidence about end-to-end tool-mediated workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 用于软件逆向工程的 LLM。 早期研究测试了 LLM 在反编译代码解读（Pearce 等人，2022；Pordanesh 和 Tan，2024；Shang 等人，2024）、反编译器优化（Hu 等人，2024）、函数名与符号恢复（Jiang 等人，2025；Xie 等人，2024；Xu 等人，2025；Yu 等人，2025）以及更广泛的二进制文件理解（Shang 等人，2026；Hu 等人，2025）方面的表现。 表示质量（包括伪代码、中间表示和恢复的语义信息）会显著影响其实用性（Hu 等人，2024；Pelayo-Benedet 等人，2026）。 漏洞分析与汇编反混淆领域的相关研究同样表明，源级能力无法直接迁移到二进制场景（Manuel 等人，2024；Fang 等人，2024；Tkachenko 等人，2025；Choi 等人，2026）。 这些研究确立了若干实用的 SRE 子任务，但为端到端的工具中介工作流提供的证据较少。

paragraphs.en: Human–Agent Comparison and Analysis Behavior. Prior work has compared humans and autonomous agents in security tasks and examined the sequence of actions they take: CTFJudge/CTFTiny ( Shao et al., 2026 ) evaluates agent behavior step by step across 50 CTF challenges, while Tang et al. ( Tang et al., 2026 ) compare autonomous agents with human teams in a live CTF setting. We therefore do not claim the first human–agent comparison in security; our contribution is specific to SRE: humans and agents analyze the same binaries, their IDA and MCP interactions are converted into common behavioral measures, and their final understanding is evaluated using the same rubric, capturing what they recover as well as how they navigate, inspect, and revisit a program. LLM assistance has also been studied for code understanding and higher-level software summaries ( Nam et al., 2024 ; Rukmono et al., 2023 ) , with known difficulties in prompt construction and intent alignment ( Zamfirescu-Pereira et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2021 ; Amershi et al., 2019 ) , and security surveys likewise report useful but unreliable reasoning beyond narrow settings ( Sheng et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Ullah et al., 2024 ) . While prior MCP evaluations focus on general tool selection and argument-syntax failures ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , our work investigates domain-specific tool orchestration within reverse-engineering workflows and directly benchmarks agent behavioral traces against a performance-calibrated human reference on identical binaries.
paragraphs.zh: 人类与智能体的比较与分析行为。 先前的研究已在安全任务中比较了人类与自主智能体，并考察了它们所采取的行动序列：CTFJudge/CTFTiny（Shao 等人，2026）对 50 项 CTF 挑战中的智能体行为进行了逐步评估，而 Tang 等人 （Tang 等人，2026）则在真实的 CTF 环境中将自主智能体与人类团队进行了比较。 因此，我们并不声称这是安全领域的首次人类与智能体的比较；我们的贡献专门针对 SRE：人类和智能体分析相同的二进制文件，它们的 IDA 和 MCP 交互被转化为共同的行为指标，并且它们最终的理解通过相同的评分标准进行评估，以捕捉它们恢复的内容以及它们如何导航、检查并重新审视程序。 LLM 辅助在代码理解和更高级别的软件摘要方面也得到了研究（Nam 等人，2024；Rukmono 等人，2023），但提示构建和意图对齐方面存在已知困难（Zamfirescu-Pereira 等人，2023；Zhang 等人，2021；Amershi 等人，2019）；安全领域的综述同样报告了在某些有限场景之外，其推理虽有用但并不可靠（Sheng 等人，2025；Ding 等人，2025；Ullah 等人，2024）。 尽管先前的 MCP 评估主要集中在通用工具选择和参数语法错误上（Luo 等人，2025），我们的研究则探讨了逆向工程工作流程中的领域特定工具协同，并直接在相同的二进制文件上将智能体的行为轨迹与经过性能校准的人类参考进行基准对比。

paragraphs.en: RQ2: exact small-sample tests. Each ablation compares five baselines with five ablation runs per model and challenge. With ten observations, we use an exact permutation test: we enumerate all ( 10 5 ) = 252 \binom{10}{5}=252 splits of the pooled scores into two groups of five and compute how often a split yields a mean difference at least as large as the observed one. We also report Cliff’s δ \delta ( δ = + 1 \delta=+1 : every ablation score exceeds every baseline score). The 18 source-code comparisons and the 90 static no-MCP comparisons (nine models × \times five representations × \times two challenges) form separate BH families. For claims about model groups (e.g., open-weight), we permute condition labels only within each model’s own runs and average the per-model differences, so each model has equal weight. Claims that an ablation reaches the human reference require both a corrected improvement over its baseline and corrected non-inferiority as in RQ1; claims that an ablation maintains performance use two one-sided tests (TOST) with a ± 1 \pm 1 -point equivalence margin.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：精确的小样本检验。 每次消融分析均比较五种基线模型，每个模型和每个挑战任务进行五次消融运行。 对于十次观察，我们使用精确的排列检验：枚举所有 \binom{10}{5}=252 种将合并得分划分为两个五组分的方法，并计算有多少种划分产生的均值差异至少与观察到的差异一样大。 我们还报告了 Cliff’s δ（δ = +1：每次消融分析的得分均高于所有基线模型的得分）。 18 组源代码比较和 90 组静态无 MCP 比较（九种模型 × 五种表示 × 两种挑战）构成了独立的 BH 族。 对于关于模型组（例如开放权重模型）的结论，我们仅在每个模型自身的运行结果中重新排列条件标签，并对各模型差异取平均值，因此每个模型具有相等的权重。 声称某次消融分析达到人类参考水平的结论，需要同时满足相对于其基线模型的校正后改进以及如 RQ1 中的校正后非劣效性；而声称某次消融分析保持性能的结论则使用两个单侧检验（TOST），并采用 ±1 分的等值性边界。

paragraphs.en: Agents access IDA Pro 9.3 through the same model-neutral MCP harness and its idalib headless interface. Every model receives the same 61-tool schema, task-prompt structure, logging layer, and reverse-engineering interface, ensuring that differences in performance reflect the models themselves rather than differences in the surrounding infrastructure. Our instrumented IDA Pro MCP plugin ( IDA Pro MCP, 2025 ) logs each tool call, its arguments, outputs, and timestamps; each run yields an action trace and a final writeup. The simple prompt template supplies the challenge description but no analysis strategy, keeping the setting close to the prior human study ( Basque et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Every model–challenge configuration is repeated five times, making manual grading impractical at our scale: the 630 agent writeups (90 baseline MCP runs, 90 source-code-replacement runs, and 450 static no-MCP runs; nine models × \times two challenges × \times five repetitions per condition) contain 630 × 7 = 4,410 630\times 7=4{,}410 understanding points to check. We therefore use GPT-5.1 to evaluate each writeup, both the agent-generated writeups and the expert-labeled human writeups, against the seven boolean understanding questions for each challenge. For every evaluated answer, GPT-5.1 also returns a confidence score. We validate this grader against 96 expert-labeled human writeups ( Basque et al., 2026 ) that were manually validated, as well as through a manual audit of 200 predictions from the full set of evaluated agent writeups, described next.
paragraphs.zh: 每种模型–挑战配置都重复五次，在我们这个规模下，手动评分变得不切实际：630 份智能体写作（90 次基础 MCP 运行、90 次源代码替换运行和 450 次静态无 MCP 运行；九种模型 × \times 两种挑战 × \times 每种条件下的五次重复）包含 630 × 7 = 4,410 个需要检查的理解点（630\times 7=4{,}410）。 因此，我们使用 GPT-5.1 来评估每一份写作，包括智能体生成的写作和专家标注的人类写作，并针对每种挑战的七个布尔理解问题进行比较。 对于每一份被评估的答案，GPT-5.1 还会返回一个置信度分数。 我们通过 96 份经过手动验证的专家标注人类写作（Basque 等人，2026），以及对全部智能体写作中 200 个预测结果的手动审计，来验证该评分器，具体方法如下文所述。

paragraphs.en: For the manual audit, we follow Zheng et al. ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) and sample 200 agent predictions. We stratify the samples by challenge, deployment class (frontier vs. open-weight), predicted label, and confidence stratum, where confidence is divided at a calibrated threshold of 0.93 0.93 obtained via Platt scaling ( Platt, 2000 ) . On the held-out expert-labeled human writeups, which serve as ground truth for this calibration, predictions above this threshold achieve 96.45% precision. This stratification ensures that both reliable and uncertain predictions are represented. Samples are allocated proportionally, with at least two samples per cell, using a fixed random seed. Three independent annotators reached substantial agreement (Fleiss’ κ = 0.76 \kappa=0.76 ). Measured against their consensus, GPT-5.1 achieves 94.5% overall accuracy (F1 = 0.94 =0.94 ) and 96.6% accuracy on the high-confidence stratum. These results support the use of automated grading for the full evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Methods. We compare agents and humans using the same seven-point understanding rubric from prior work ( Basque et al., 2026 ) . Each agent is run five times per challenge ( RPC and Secrets ) to capture run-to-run variability.

sents.en: We compare agents and humans using the same seven-point understanding rubric from prior work ( Basque et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: Each agent is run five times per challenge ( RPC and Secrets ) to capture run-to-run variability.

paragraphs.en: Our human reference is performance-based rather than solely on participants’ self-reported expertise labels. Basque et al. define understanding rate as understanding score divided by solve time and validate it as a meaningful SRE-performance measure: in their human study, self-reported experts have significantly higher understanding rates than novices ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 , reported effect size 0.57 0.57 ) ( Basque et al., 2026 ) . Their strategy analysis likewise ranks participants by understanding rate and contrasts top- and bottom-performing cohorts. Using that validated construct, we rank the 48 participants separately for each challenge based on understanding rate. For each challenge, we use the 10 highest-rated participants as the top-human reference and the 10 lowest-rated participants as a lower descriptive reference. The actual comparison with agents, however, is based solely on the raw understanding score , the total number of rubric points achieved, regardless of time: the rate tells us who the best humans are, while the non-inferiority test asks whether an agent’s final understanding is practically no worse than what those humans achieved.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的人类参考标准基于表现，而不仅仅是依据参与者自我报告的专家标签。 Basque 等人将理解率定义为理解分数除以解题时间，并验证其为衡量 SRE 表现的有意义指标：在他们的人类研究中，自报为专家的参与者比新手具有显著更高的理解率（p = 0.001，报告效应量为 0.57）（Basque 等人，2026）。 他们的策略分析同样根据理解率对参与者进行排序，并对比表现最好和最差的群体。 基于这一经过验证的指标，我们针对每项挑战，根据理解率对 48 名参与者分别进行排序。 对于每项挑战，我们将评分最高的 10 名参与者作为顶级人类参考标准，而将评分最低的 10 名参与者作为较低的描述性参考标准。 然而，与智能体的实际比较仅基于原始理解分数，即获得的评分标准总分，而不考虑时间因素：理解率告诉我们哪些是人类中的最佳表现者，而非劣性检验则旨在判断智能体的最终理解水平是否在实践上不低于这些人类参与者的表现。

sents.en: Our human reference is performance-based rather than solely on participants’ self-reported expertise labels.
sents.zh: 我们的人类参考标准基于表现，而不仅仅是依据参与者自我报告的专家标签。

sents.en: Basque et al. define understanding rate as understanding score divided by solve time and validate it as a meaningful SRE-performance measure: in their human study, self-reported experts have significantly higher understanding rates than novices ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 , reported effect size 0.57 0.57 ) ( Basque et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Basque 等人将理解率定义为理解分数除以解题时间，并验证其为衡量 SRE 表现的有意义指标：在他们的人类研究中，自报为专家的参与者比新手具有显著更高的理解率（p = 0.001，报告效应量为 0.57）（Basque 等人，2026）。

sents.en: Their strategy analysis likewise ranks participants by understanding rate and contrasts top- and bottom-performing cohorts.
sents.zh: 他们的策略分析同样根据理解率对参与者进行排序，并对比表现最好和最差的群体。

sents.en: Using that validated construct, we rank the 48 participants separately for each challenge based on understanding rate.
sents.zh: 基于这一经过验证的指标，我们针对每项挑战，根据理解率对 48 名参与者分别进行排序。

sents.en: For each challenge, we use the 10 highest-rated participants as the top-human reference and the 10 lowest-rated participants as a lower descriptive reference.
sents.zh: 对于每项挑战，我们将评分最高的 10 名参与者作为顶级人类参考标准，而将评分最低的 10 名参与者作为较低的描述性参考标准。

sents.en: The actual comparison with agents, however, is based solely on the raw understanding score , the total number of rubric points achieved, regardless of time: the rate tells us who the best humans are, while the non-inferiority test asks whether an agent’s final understanding is practically no worse than what those humans achieved.
sents.zh: 然而，与智能体的实际比较仅基于原始理解分数，即获得的评分标准总分，而不考虑时间因素：理解率告诉我们哪些是人类中的最佳表现者，而非劣性检验则旨在判断智能体的最终理解水平是否在实践上不低于这些人类参与者的表现。

paragraphs.en: We organize agents into four RQ1 analysis groups: Frontier , Single-GPU , Multi-GPU , and Large-Scale Accelerator . The primary analysis compares the Frontier agents group with the top-human reference using the non-inferiority test described in Section 3.1 : we test whether the agent group’s understanding score is within Δ = 1 \Delta=1 rubric point of the top-human reference. We choose this margin because one point corresponds to a single item in the understanding rubric and represents a realistic difference even among skilled human reverse engineers: in the prior human study ( Basque et al., 2026 ) , high-performing and expert participants did not always recover every understanding item, and one-point omissions occurred even among strong performances. We therefore treat an agent as practically non-inferior only when the data allow us to rule out a deficit greater than one rubric point relative to the top-human reference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将智能体分为四个 RQ1 分析组：Frontier、Single-GPU、Multi-GPU 和 Large-Scale Accelerator。 主要分析通过第 3.1 节中描述的非劣效性检验，将 Frontier 智能体组与顶尖人类参考表现进行比较：我们检验该智能体组的理解分数是否与顶尖人类参考表现相差在 Δ = 1 \Delta=1 评分点以内。 我们选择这一差异阈值，因为一个评分点对应理解评分表中的单个条目，即使对于技术娴熟的人类逆向工程师而言，这样的差异也是合理的：在先前的人类研究中（Basque et al., 2026），表现优异和专家级的参与者也并非总能完全恢复所有理解条目，即使在表现出色的情况下，也会出现遗漏一个评分点的情况。 因此，只有当数据能够排除与顶尖人类参考表现相比超过一个评分点的差距时，我们才认为该智能体在实践上非劣效。

paragraphs.en: Looking at individual agents rather than tier averages reveals important differences that the group-level analysis obscures. After BH correction across the 18 per-agent comparisons, GPT-5.5 Pro is non-inferior on both RPC ( q = 0.0087 q=0.0087 ) and Secrets ( q < 0.001 q<0.001 ) with respect to the top-human reference; Claude Opus 4.8 is also non-inferior on both ( q = 0.024 q=0.024 and 0.013 0.013 , respectively). Kimi K3, although in the Large-Scale Accelerator group, likewise satisfies non-inferiority on both challenges ( q = 0.024 q=0.024 and 0.013 0.013 ), while Gemini 2.5 Pro does not satisfy the criterion for either challenge. None of the Single-GPU, Multi-GPU, or Large-Scale Accelerator groups establishes non-inferiority as a tier, showing that deployment class alone is not a sufficient predictor of competency. Efficiency provides an additional perspective on these results. Across the baseline runs of the three models that establish non-inferiority on both challenges (GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, and Kimi K3) mean solve time is 628 s (10.5 min) on RPC and 666 s (11.1 min) on Secrets , versus 4,498 s (75.0 min) and 2,797 s (46.6 min) for the high-performing human cohort: successful agents complete the analysis approximately 7.2 × 7.2\times and 4.2 × 4.2\times faster, respectively.

paragraphs.en: Context saturation. One possible explanation for failure is context saturation, meaning that the accumulated session history exceeds the agent’s effective context window. We therefore measure both baseline saturation, caused by the fixed prompt and 61-tool schema, and final saturation at the end of each session, which is related to tool usage and data ingestion. Overall, saturation remains low across all window sizes. Models with the smallest windows (Llama 3.3 and GPT-OSS, 131 131 k) end sessions at 5.3 % 5.3\% – 9.2 % 9.2\% . The worst case is Gemma 4 ( 256 256 k), which doubles from 7.2 % 7.2\% to 14.1 % 14.1\% on RPC , the highest average final saturation of all agents. Qwen3.5 9B barely moves ( 7.2 % → 7.4 % 7.2\%\to 7.4\% ), consistent with sessions that end after very few tool calls. Mid-size windows (DeepSeek V4 Pro, 512 512 k) end at about 7.5 % 7.5\% , while agents with ≥ \geq 1M-token windows, including the strongest ones (GPT-5.5 Pro, Kimi K3), never use past 6 % 6\% of their context budget by session end. The full per-model table is available in our repository ( Section 12 ). Since no average final saturation exceeds 14.1 % 14.1\% , the raw context window size does not explain the baseline failures on these compact tasks.

paragraphs.en: Tool-calling failures. Among the 17 zero-score runs, 70.6% make only minimal, non-investigative use of the available tools before terminating, issuing 2 or less actionable tool calls. In these runs, the agent nonetheless returns a full writeup, but its claims are hallucinated, given the little or no evidence it actually gathered, rather than grounded in the code it inspected. This failure mode appears exclusively in open-weight agents; frontier agents always engage substantively with the MCP interface, even in poor runs. The remaining zero-score traces are active but unproductive: they make more than 2 tool calls yet still fail to translate the returned information into progress. Thus, weak runs include both tool-orchestration collapse (minimal, superficial tool use paired with an unsupported, hallucinated writeup) and engaged sessions that either fail to exploit the information they retrieve or fail to submit a final answer. Frontier agents concentrate more of their tool budget on code reading ( decompile covers 31.4 % 31.4\% of their total tool calls), whereas failing agents overuse get_string , which accounts for 33.7 % 33.7\% of their total tool calls. This trace evidence motivates the controlled representation and interface ablations below, but by itself does not identify whether the underlying difference is reasoning ability, planning, interface adaptation, or their interaction.

paragraphs.en: Methods. We first test whether the semantic quality of the returned code affects performance while retaining the interactive workflow. We patch the IDA Pro plugin so that decompile tool call returns the original function source code rather than decompiled pseudocode, while leaving the models, prompt, tool schema, and MCP interaction loop unchanged. We compare each model–challenge condition with its five baseline MCP runs using a two-sided permutation test on the mean score difference (as detailed in Section 3.1 ), testing both each model individually and population-level effects across all models or sub-groups (open-weight, Frontier). Because we test nine models across two challenges, this yields 18 individual comparisons, corrected together as a single BH family, with q q denoting the BH-corrected p p -value. We use a model-stratified exact permutation test that gives each model equal weight (so that a single strong or weak model does not dominate the group result) and apply BH correction across the six reported group–challenge tests (All models × \times 2 challenges, Open-weight × \times 2, Frontier × \times 2).

paragraphs.en: Results. Source-code replacement produces a positive aggregate shift in understanding score. Across all nine models, mean performance increases by 0.80 0.80 points on RPC ( q = 0.0120 q=0.0120 ) and 0.58 0.58 on Secrets ( q = 0.0497 q=0.0497 ). paragraphs.en: Results. The layer-based descriptive analysis already suggests a strong navigation asymmetry. At the first visit ( k = 1 k{=}1 ), agents allocate 81.6% of movements to jumps, compared with 19.0% for humans; at deeper layers, agent movement remains jump-heavy. This jump-heavy pattern suggests a strategy we term greedy fetching : instead of following call-graph structure step by step, strong agents typically jump to non-adjacent functions, fetch new code, and continue reasoning over newly retrieved information, revisiting relatively little. Greedy fetching describes how information is acquired, not simply how much of the binary is eventually covered. On compact binaries, this can be effective because much of the relevant program can be gathered quickly; as programs grow, however, aggressive retrieval may increase tool overhead and consume the available context before the agent can consolidate what it has seen. We treat this as a hypothesis at this stage: the next subsection, RQ4, examines and measures its scalability.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 基于层的描述性分析已经表明存在明显的导航不对称性。 在首次访问时（k = 1），智能体将 81.6% 的移动分配给跳跃，而人类仅为 19.0%；在更深层中，智能体的移动仍以跳跃为主。 这种以跳跃为主的模式表明了一种我们称之为“贪婪获取”的策略：强大的智能体通常不会按步骤遵循调用图结构，而是直接跳跃到非相邻函数，获取新代码，并对新检索到的信息继续推理，而很少重复访问。 “贪婪获取”描述的是信息的获取方式，而不仅仅是最终覆盖的二进制文件大小。 在紧凑型二进制文件中，这种方法可能有效，因为大部分相关程序可以快速收集；然而，随着程序规模增大，激进的信息检索可能会增加工具开销，并在智能体整合已有信息之前耗尽可用上下文。 现阶段我们将其视为一种假设：下一小节 RQ4 将检验并衡量其可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: To see how and where greedy fetching manifests, we measure these four metrics on the strong-performing cohorts established in RQ1: the top-performing human participants and all five baseline MCP runs from the three non-inferior models (GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, Kimi K3). Because the 15 agent runs (three models × \times five runs for each challenge) share underlying models, they are not truly independent. paragraphs.en: Methods. We construct four groups of real-world binaries (Windows/Linux and system/application). To avoid choosing an arbitrary application workload, we ground application selection in public popularity rankings. On Windows, we randomly select and install 50 applications from the Microsoft Store’s Most popular apps for PC listing available at the time of collection ( Microsoft, ) . On Linux, we follow the same approach on a clean Ubuntu 24.04 system, randomly selecting and installing 50 popular application packages using the Debian Popularity Contest (PopCon) as the popularity source ( Debian Project, ) . On Windows, we distinguish system and application binaries based on standard directory locations. On Linux, we isolate application binaries by hashing directories before and after installing the selected software, removing any binaries already present in the baseline. Following state-of-the-art practice ( Dambra et al., 2023 ) , we use Detect-It-Easy ( Detect-It-Easy, 2025 ) to filter framework and packer code (e.g., .NET , PyInstaller , Electron ) that hides the real app’s code. We remove duplicates by considering their SHA-256 values, randomly select 1,000 binaries per group, and extract complete decompiled and disassembled representations using IDA Pro. We then tokenize each representation using the appropriate tokenizer for each evaluated model and compute context-window saturation as the ratio of the token count to the model’s context window size. A saturation of 100 % 100\% or higher indicates that the representation fills the entire context window.
paragraphs.zh: 方法。 我们构建四组真实世界二进制文件（Windows/Linux 和系统/应用）。 为避免随意选择应用工作负载，我们以公开的流行度排名为基础来选择应用。 在 Windows 上，我们从收集时 Microsoft Store 的“PC 端最热门应用”列表中随机选择并安装 50 款应用（Microsoft,）。 在 Linux 上，我们在干净的 Ubuntu 24.04 系统上采用相同方法，基于 Debian Popularity Contest (PopCon) 提供的流行度数据，随机选择并安装 50 个热门应用包（Debian Project,）。 在 Windows 上，我们根据标准目录位置区分系统和应用二进制文件。 在 Linux 上，我们通过在安装所选软件前后对目录进行哈希处理来隔离应用二进制文件，并移除基线中已存在的任何二进制文件。 遵循当前最先进的实践（Dambra et al., 2023），我们使用 Detect-It-Easy (Detect-It-Easy, 2025) 过滤框架和打包器代码（例如 .NET、PyInstaller、Electron），这些代码会隐藏真实应用的代码。 我们通过 SHA-256 值去除重复项，每组随机选择 1,000 个二进制文件，并使用 IDA Pro 提取完整的反编译和反汇编表示。 接着，我们使用每个被评估模型对应的适当分词器对每种表示进行分词，并将上下文窗口饱和度计算为分词数量与模型上下文窗口大小的比率。 100% 或更高的饱和度表示该表示已填满整个上下文窗口。

sents.en: On Linux, we isolate application binaries by hashing directories before and after installing the selected software, removing any binaries already present in the baseline.

sents.en: Following state-of-the-art practice ( Dambra et al., 2023 ) , we use Detect-It-Easy ( Detect-It-Easy, 2025 ) to filter framework and packer code (e.g., .NET , PyInstaller , Electron ) that hides the real app’s code.
sents.zh: 遵循当前最先进的实践（Dambra et al., 2023），我们使用 Detect-It-Easy (Detect-It-Easy, 2025) 过滤框架和打包器代码（例如 .NET、PyInstaller、Electron），这些代码会隐藏真实应用的代码。

sents.en: We remove duplicates by considering their SHA-256 values, randomly select 1,000 binaries per group, and extract complete decompiled and disassembled representations using IDA Pro.

sents.en: We then tokenize each representation using the appropriate tokenizer for each evaluated model and compute context-window saturation as the ratio of the token count to the model’s context window size.

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these patterns show that greedy fetching through complete binary retrieval is only conditionally feasible in practice. Even for models with context windows of at least 1 ​ M 1M tokens (e.g., GPT-5.5 Pro, Kimi K3), the share of binaries that saturate the window on decompiled code ranges from 1.9% for Linux system binaries to 39.1% for Windows applications, so complete decompiled retrieval occurs in 60.9-98.1% of cases depending on the binary group. paragraphs.en: The practical implication is that context saturation is a scalability boundary rather than the primary explanation for failures on the compact benchmark tasks. An agent that retrieves large amounts of decompiled code can fit the entire binary into context in many real-world cases, but in the remaining cases, more selective retrieval and state management are required than greedy fetching alone provides.
paragraphs.zh: 其实际意义在于，上下文饱和更多是扩展性的边界，而非紧凑基准任务中失败的主要原因。 在许多现实场景中，能够检索大量反编译代码的智能体可以将整个二进制文件纳入上下文；但在其余情况下，则需要比单纯贪婪式获取更具选择性的检索和状态管理。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, our results do not show that autonomous SRE has been solved. They do, however, fit a broader trend reported in prior work: autonomous agents are making inroads into a domain that traditionally depended on skilled human reverse engineers ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Nishizaka et al., 2026 ; Radey et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: 1. Human-competitive SRE is possible, but not yet general. RQ1 shows that, on these two compact static-analysis SRE tasks, human-level performance is strongly model-dependent. GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, and Kimi K3 satisfy the non-inferiority criterion on both challenges, but the large differences among agents make it clear this capability should not yet be generalized to smaller, workstation-scale LLMs. While Kimi K3 shows open-weight models can achieve this, its size still requires accelerator infrastructure; bringing this capability to ordinary local hardware remains an important future direction for analyzing sensitive software.
paragraphs.zh: 1. 达到人类水平的 SRE 是可能的，但尚未实现通用化。 RQ1 表明，在这两项紧凑的静态分析 SRE 任务中，达到人类水平的性能高度依赖模型。 GPT-5.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4.8 和 Kimi K3 在这两项挑战中都满足了非劣效性标准，但各智能体之间的巨大差异清楚地表明，这种能力尚不能推广到更小、工作站在规模的 LLM 上。 尽管 Kimi K3 表明开放权重模型可以实现这一目标，但其规模仍然需要加速器基础设施；将这种能力引入普通的本地硬件，仍然是分析敏感软件的重要未来方向。

paragraphs.en: 2. Agent capability depends on tool and analysis fidelity. RQ2 shows that model quality alone does not explain performance: weaker agents either never establish a productive tool-use loop or retrieve information but fail to turn it into understanding, so autonomous SRE depends on both reasoning capability and the ability to operate the analysis workflow. Our ablations clarify this: providing the complete decompiled program directly yields substantially larger improvements than returning the original source code via MCP, particularly for open-weight models. Removing MCP alone is not sufficient; representation quality, search burden, tool orchestration, and reasoning ability all contribute. Future agents must therefore treat the interface as an integral part of the system.
paragraphs.zh: 2. 智能体的能力取决于工具和分析的保真度。 RQ2 表明，仅凭模型质量无法解释性能表现：较弱的智能体要么从未建立有效的工具使用循环，要么虽然能获取信息却无法将其转化为理解，因此自主 SRE 既需要推理能力，也需要操作分析工作流程的能力。 我们的消融研究阐明了这一点：直接提供完整的反编译程序所带来的改进，远大于通过 MCP 返回原始源代码，尤其是在开源模型中。 仅移除 MCP 并不足够；表示质量、搜索负担、工具协调和推理能力都会产生影响。 因此，未来的智能体必须将接口视为系统不可分割的一部分。

paragraphs.en: 3. Strong agents reach similar coverage through a very different strategy. Humans and strong agents eventually inspect similarly broad portions of the binaries, but they reach that coverage in very different ways: agents exhibit substantially more non-call-graph jumping and substantially less revisitation, a behavior we call greedy fetching , rather than repeatedly traversing structure and returning to inspected code; agents aggressively move toward new functions and reason over what is accumulated in context. While prior work has found that sequential exploration is characteristic of human novices ( Mantovani et al., 2022 ) , agents bypass structured exploration entirely: when sufficient code fits within the context, broad exposure can substitute for the structured memory-management strategies humans need.
paragraphs.zh: 3. 强大的智能体通过截然不同的策略实现了类似的覆盖范围。 人类和强大的智能体最终都会检查大致同样广度的二进制代码，但它们实现这一覆盖范围的方式截然不同：智能体表现出明显更多的非调用图跳转和明显更少的重复访问——我们将这种行为称为“贪婪获取”——而不是反复遍历结构并返回已检查的代码；智能体会积极转向新函数，并对上下文中积累的内容进行推理。 尽管先前的研究指出顺序探索是人类新手的特点（Mantovani 等，2022），但智能体完全跳过了结构化探索：当足够的代码能够容纳在上下文中时，广泛的接触就可以替代人类所需的结构化内存管理策略。

paragraphs.en: 4. Greedy fetching is an adaptation, not a fixed property of agents. The source-code intervention reveals greedy-fetching changes when the information environment changes: when strong models receive semantically richer source responses via MCP, function coverage and read activity decrease significantly, while understanding remains the same. Agents do not fetch aggressively out of an immutable preference for reading code; rather, greedy fetching is useful when information is fragmented, and retrieval is cheap, so richer information means agents need less of it. Interfaces that expose better abstractions may reduce unnecessary exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 4. 贪婪式获取是一种适应性策略，而非智能体的固定属性。 源代码干预表明，当信息环境发生变化时，贪婪式获取也会随之改变：当强大模型通过 MCP 接收到语义更丰富的源响应时，函数覆盖范围和读取活动会显著减少，而理解能力则保持不变。 智能体并非出于对阅读代码的不可改变偏好而进行激进式获取；相反，当信息碎片化且检索成本较低时，贪婪式获取才更为有效，因此信息越丰富，智能体所需的信息就越少。 提供更优抽象层的接口或许能减少不必要的探索行为。

paragraphs.en: 5. Context capacity changes the agent’s SRE strategy. Across real-world binaries, complete decompiled representations often fit within large context windows, but saturation becomes substantially more common for large Windows apps. This bounds the greedy fetching strategy: when programs exceed the context budget, agents must decide what information to enter into context, discard, or keep for later reasoning. Larger context windows can move this boundary, but do not remove it. Next-generation SRE systems will therefore need mechanisms that current agents use weakly: selective retrieval , persistent analysis state , and evidence-driven revisitation .
paragraphs.zh: 5. 上下文容量会改变智能体的 SRE 策略。 在真实世界的二进制文件中，完整的反编译表示通常能容纳在较大的上下文窗口中，但对于大型 Windows 应用程序而言，上下文饱和现象会显著更常见。 这限制了贪婪获取策略：当程序超出上下文预算时，智能体必须决定将哪些信息纳入上下文、丢弃或保留用于后续推理。 更大的上下文窗口可以调整这一界限，但无法消除它。 因此，下一代 SRE 系统将需要采用当前智能体仅弱使用的机制：选择性检索、持久化分析状态以及基于证据的重新审视。

sents.en: Context capacity changes the agent’s SRE strategy.
sents.zh: 上下文容量会改变智能体的 SRE 策略。

sents.zh: 在真实世界的二进制文件中，完整的反编译表示通常能容纳在较大的上下文窗口中，但对于大型 Windows 应用程序而言，上下文饱和现象会显著更常见。

sents.en: This bounds the greedy fetching strategy: when programs exceed the context budget, agents must decide what information to enter into context, discard, or keep for later reasoning.
sents.zh: 这限制了贪婪获取策略：当程序超出上下文预算时，智能体必须决定将哪些信息纳入上下文、丢弃或保留用于后续推理。

sents.en: Larger context windows can move this boundary, but do not remove it.
sents.zh: 更大的上下文窗口可以调整这一界限，但无法消除它。

sents.en: Next-generation SRE systems will therefore need mechanisms that current agents use weakly: selective retrieval , persistent analysis state , and evidence-driven revisitation .

paragraphs.en: Task scope and external validity. We measure SRE performance using two compact, static-analysis CTF-style challenges. This provides a controlled, reproducible setting, but does not cover all of real-world SRE. Our results do not imply that agents perform robustly on all security tasks. However, this restricted setting enables our matched human–agent comparison using the same understanding rubric. While broader benchmarks exist ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Shao et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) , they lack the matched human writeups and fine-grained IDA traces required for our behavioral analysis. RQ4 partially addresses this by evaluating whether complete representations of real-world binaries fit in model contexts, though it measures scalability rather than reasoning. Furthermore, the evaluation interface itself is static-only, with no debugger or dynamic/runtime execution path (Section 3.3 ), because it intentionally matches the static IDA-based setting used in the human reference study. This does not imply that dynamic analysis is unimportant for real-world SRE; extending this comparison to dynamic tooling is left to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 任务范围与外部效度。 我们使用两个简洁的静态分析式 CTF 风格挑战来衡量 SRE 性能。 这提供了一个受控且可复现的环境，但并未涵盖所有现实世界的 SRE 场景。 我们的结果并不意味着智能体在所有安全任务中都能表现出稳健性。 然而，这种受限环境使我们能够使用相同的理解评分标准，对匹配的人类与智能体进行比较。 尽管存在更广泛的基准测试（Liu et al., 2026；Shao et al., 2026；Tang et al., 2026），但它们缺乏我们行为分析所需的匹配人类撰写说明和精细的 IDA 追踪数据。 RQ4 通过评估现实世界二进制文件的完整表示能否适配模型上下文，部分解决了这一问题，尽管它衡量的是可扩展性而非推理能力。 此外，评估界面本身仅支持静态分析，没有调试器或动态/运行时执行路径（第 3.3 节），因为该设计有意与人类参考研究中使用的基于静态 IDA 的环境保持一致。 这并不意味着动态分析对现实世界的 SRE 不重要；将这种比较扩展到动态工具属于未来工作的范畴。

paragraphs.en: Training-data contamination. Because the challenge binaries and their source code were released publicly before some models’ training cutoffs, we cannot rule out the possibility that models were exposed to the underlying implementation during training. The structured 7-point scoring rubrics, ground-truth solution writeups, and fine-grained human interaction logs, by contrast, were never made public, which reduces the risk that models memorized the specific evaluation criteria or reference solutions. This does not, however, eliminate the possibility of prior exposure to the source code itself, and we treat training-data contamination as an unresolved threat to validity rather than a risk we can rule out.
paragraphs.zh: 训练数据污染。 由于挑战赛的二进制文件及其源代码在某些模型的训练截止时间之前已公开发布，因此我们无法排除模型在训练过程中接触到底层实现的可能性。 相比之下，结构化的7分评分标准、基准答案说明以及细致的人类交互日志从未公开，这降低了模型记住具体评估标准或参考解答的风险。 然而，这并未排除模型先前接触过源代码本身的可能性，我们将训练数据污染视为对有效性的一个未解决的威胁，而非可以排除的风险。

paragraphs.en: Human reference and non-inferiority margin. RQ1 defines the strongest human reference using the understanding-rate measure ( Basque et al., 2026 ) , which determines who enters the reference cohort , while the RQ1 outcome itself is the raw understanding score. Our Δ = 1 \Delta=1 margin represents a single understanding concept, as even strong humans sometimes miss a rubric item, so non-inferiority indicates practical comparability under this explicit tolerance, not equivalence to all professional reverse engineers. Relatedly, the RQ2 ablations change the overall analysis environment rather than isolating single causal factors: providing the original source restores names, types, and structure (an upper-bound representation experiment rather than a pure decompiler test), while the no-MCP experiment removes tool-selection costs, search effort, and interaction failures while changing context organization. We therefore interpret these ablations as environmental changes rather than clean causal decompositions.
paragraphs.zh: 人类参考与无劣效性阈值。 RQ1 通过理解率指标（Basque 等，2026）定义了最强的人类参考基准，该指标决定了哪些人进入参考组，而 RQ1 的结果本身则是原始理解得分。 我们的 Δ = 1 \Delta=1 阈值代表单个理解概念，因为即使是能力很强的人类有时也会遗漏评分标准中的某一项，因此无劣效性表明在此明确容限下存在实际可比性，而非与所有专业逆向工程师完全等同。 相关地，RQ2 的消融分析改变了整体分析环境，而非孤立地考察单个因果因素：提供原始源代码会恢复名称、类型和结构（这是一个上限表示实验，而非纯粹的解编译器测试），而“无 MCP”实验则移除了工具选择成本、搜索努力和交互失败，同时改变了上下文组织方式。 因此，我们将这些消融分析解释为环境变化，而非纯粹的因果分解。

paragraphs.en: Comparing human and agent behavior. RQ3 compares manual IDA interactions with agent MCP interactions; the raw events are not directly equivalent, so we address this by mapping behaviors to shared abstractions ( J J , C C , R R ) based on the recovered call graph. Read share ( Q Q ) remains the least directly comparable due to differences in granularity, so we do not rely on it alone to claim strategy differences. Our behavioral reference is the ten strongest unassisted participants per challenge ( Basque et al., 2026 ) , who should not be conflated with the general professional population; to ensure statistical validity, we perform inference at the model-cluster level to avoid pseudo-replication, use hierarchical bootstrap intervals, and apply BH correction across the eight planned comparisons. On interpretation: strong agents jump between structurally unrelated functions more often than humans and revisit functions less often, without achieving significantly broader function coverage, so greedy fetching is an alternative method of acquiring information; RQ3 shows this behavior diminishes with richer program information, indicating it is an environmental adaptation rather than an intrinsic agentic property.
paragraphs.zh: 比较人类与智能体的行为。 研究问题3（RQ3）将人工IDA交互与智能体MCP交互进行了比较；原始事件并不直接等价，因此我们基于恢复出的调用图，将行为映射到共享的抽象概念（J J、C C、R R）来解决这一问题。 共享读取（Q Q）由于粒度差异而仍然是最难以直接比较的指标，因此我们不单独依赖它来断言策略存在差异。 我们的行为参考标准是每项挑战中表现最强的十位无辅助参与者（Basque et al., 2026），他们不应与一般专业人士群体混为一谈；为确保统计有效性，我们在模型簇层面进行推断以避免伪重复，使用分层自助法置信区间，并对计划中的八项比较应用BH校正。 关于解释：强大的智能体比人类更频繁地在结构上无关的功能之间切换，且较少重复访问同一功能，但并未实现显著更广泛的功能覆盖；因此，贪婪式获取是另一种信息获取方法；研究问题3（RQ3）表明，随着程序信息的丰富，这种行为会减弱，说明这是一种环境适应，而非智能体固有的特性。

paragraphs.en: Model reproducibility. Evaluating closed-frontier models affects long-term reproducibility as providers update their systems; we mitigate this by reporting experimental configurations and evaluating open-weight models, but exact reproduction of closed-model behavior may become impossible.
paragraphs.zh: 模型可重复性。 对封闭前沿模型进行评估会影响长期可重复性，因为提供商会不断更新其系统；我们通过报告实验配置和评估开放权重模型来缓解这一问题，但精确复现封闭模型的行为可能变得不可能。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous SRE is no longer only a question of whether an agent is capable enough. Our results show that, under this controlled two-task setting, some agents can already reach human-competitive understanding on compact, static-analysis SRE tasks, and do so much faster, but their success depends strongly on the surrounding analysis environment.
paragraphs.zh: 自主 SRE 的问题不再仅仅是智能体是否足够有能力。 我们的研究结果表明，在这种受控的双任务设置下，某些智能体已经能够在紧凑的静态分析 SRE 任务中达到与人类相当的理解水平，而且速度更快，但它们的成功在很大程度上取决于周围的分析环境。

paragraphs.en: We identify greedy fetching as a distinct agent strategy: strong agents jump aggressively across a binary, retrieve new information quickly, and revisit far less than human analysts. This behavior changes with richer representations and eventually runs into context limits as programs grow, so future progress will require better interfaces, selective retrieval, persistent analysis state, and more deliberate revisitation, not simply larger context windows.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将贪婪式获取视为一种独特的智能体策略：强大的智能体会在二元结构中激进地跳跃，快速检索新信息，但重访信息的频率远低于人类分析师。 随着表示形式的丰富，这种行为会发生改变；当程序规模扩大时，最终会遭遇上下文限制。因此，未来的进步将需要更优的接口、选择性检索、持久的分析状态以及更有策略的重访机制，而不仅仅是更大的上下文窗口。

paragraphs.en: If humans and machines can reach the same understanding through fundamentally different paths, then the question is no longer only whether machines can reverse engineer, but what understanding means when the path to it is no longer uniquely human.
paragraphs.zh: 如果人类和机器能够通过截然不同的路径达到相同的理解，那么问题就不再仅仅是机器能否进行逆向工程，而是当达成这种理解的路径不再为人类所独有时，“理解”究竟意味着什么。

paragraphs.en: Our study constitutes human subject research (HSR), so we follow our institution’s HSR guidelines and received approval from the Institutional Review Board (IRB). In accordance with our IRB’s requirements and our own ethical considerations regarding the proper handling of our participants, all participants were fully informed of the study’s purpose, data handling procedures, and their right to withdraw at any time without penalty. They provided explicit consent for recording and data storage, and all recordings were stored on access-controlled servers in accordance with the best security practices.

paragraphs.en: To support transparency and reproducibility, we release an anonymized repository 1 1 1 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/humans_vs_machines/ containing all code, scripts, and agent results required to reproduce our experiments and analyses.
